body:
If you use the latest version of Vue InstantSearch, you can fix this by:

1. use `<ais-instantsearch :future="{ preserveSharedStateOnUnmount: true }">`
2. add a static (can be non-rendering, hidden) widget of the type that is conditionally rendered

I'll close this issue now, but the guide on https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/widgets/show-and-hide-widgets/react/ should be recreated for Vue (it behaves the same)
